roles.label: Admin / owner

roles.label: Tournament runner / organiser
roles.description: Creates events and tournament templates, manages officials and clubs.

roles.description: Scores and officiates assigned contests and can invite club owners.

roles.description: Manages their own club and its participants.

roles.label: Fighter / participant
roles.description: Registers independently or via a club invitation.
